backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented Valentine UI features, associated files, components, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Short descriptions of key frontend files including App.tsx, evasive button hook, global CSS, and Tailwind config.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base file defining theme variables, dark mode variants, and global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main Valentine UI with Yes/No buttons, evasive No behavior, and meme display after acceptance.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and managing backend actors tied to Internet Identity state with react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts: Hook generating random safe positions for the No button and handling pointer interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity auth provider and hook handling login, identity persistence, and status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Global romantic theme styles, OKLCH palette, animations, and Inter font setup.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry script initializing providers and rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins including typography, container-queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, features, requirements, and planned romantic-themed Valentine interaction behaviors for the web page.
